# Rise Personal

> Rise Personal is a personal branding agency in Dubai, UAE, serving company leaders and teams in Saudi Arabia, Egypt and the wider GCC. We practise human-powered marketing: a marketing approach built on people, not logos or products, because people trust people. We combine self-discovery, brand archetype work and wellness, and we start every client with a free assessment, the Snapshot.

## What we do

- **Personal Blueprint**: we explore your passions, voice and values and shape them into your unique print.
- **Message Mastery**: we refine your message until it carries your voice with clarity.
- **Visual Identity**: a visual language designed around you, never the other way around.
- **Personal Amplification**: mastery of media channels to make you the focal point of your market.

## Who we serve

- Primary audience: companies, meaning their leaders, founders, specialists and teams.
- Markets: Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Eastern Province), Egypt (Cairo, Alexandria), the UAE and the GCC.
- Delivery: based in Dubai; clients in Saudi Arabia and Egypt are served remotely. We do not operate offices in Saudi Arabia or Egypt.
